verdicts.reason: A reads left to right in a sensible order (logo, headline, details, illustration, actions), but the RSVP CTA is shrunk into a pill the same size as the Free Entry/All Ages/Tastings badges, so it is buried. The missing-asset partner placeholder is blown up into a large grey box that dominates the right end, and the logo and 'Solstice presents' are tiny. B's reading order is broken: the time/location line sits far left, cut off from its date, and the logo is jammed against the left edge. 'Solstice presents' floats after the illustration, the subtitle is pushed to the far right, RSVP is again just one pill in a row with a missing space ('FREEENTRY'), and the red partner placeholder collides with the Tastings pill.
